title: indigo_mount_temma: sync completes through a finalizer instead of the coordinates handler
description: The sync path of MOUNT_EQUATORIAL_COORDINATES finishes in a finalizer rather than in mount_equatorial_coordinates_handler ending with indigo_update_coordinates(), unlike the pattern set in ticket 42b85be0 (BUSY from the change branch, OK/ALERT from the handler). Check that a refused sync keeps its ALERT and that the OK publication carries the mount-reported position. Found while working on ticket 42b85be0-1f19-4607-b3c3-746e60317d17 (closed, commit a09e0f878), which introduced the kept coordinates ALERT in indigo_update_coordinates(): an ALERT published after a BUSY stays until the next BUSY. Reproduce in the driver's simulator suite before changing code.
